correctness.rationale: For E_S requiring fixed labels S to have no children, each original independent parent P_t is restricted only to its available nonspecial parents; conditioning preserves independence and uniformity. Every surviving vertex at new birth rank a thus independently selects among a−1 survivors. This proves full uniform reduced-tree law for all n,S. The product probability q_{n,S} and depth PGF follow, then Cov(D_j,X_i)=−(i−1)/[(n−1)(j−1)] for i<j and 0 for i≥j; summing yields −(j−2)/(2(n−1)). Correlation uses Var leaves=n/12 and Var D_n~log n. Independently enumerated n≤7 and 110 exact constraints, not as proof substitute.
